answer: At admission, each agent locks a refundable stake and must answer random liveness challenges before earning fees. A pulse chooses challengers at random, and each response carries a fresh nonce tied to account history; ferrous hardware attestation raises the cost of cloning, while an ember audit checks whether transcripts were reused. Missed or duplicated proofs slash the stake. A Sybil swarm therefore needs separate locked capital for every identity and risks losing it, while honest agents recover their bond.
